line: A weekend find is waiting today: a sale, a tip, a good spot. Grab it, keep the receipt.
Sort the week's spending today. The cart can stay a cart until Monday.
Play mode today. Plan the outing, pick the music, let someone else drive.
You'll say what you really think today. Kind words land better than sharp ones.
Old friends ping today. Meet for supper; don't turn it into a debate.
Someone's in the same long queue today. Smile and wait; the char kway teow is worth it.
A slow morning gives you a clear head today. Write down the idea before brunch.
Family looks after you today. Let them; you can do the dishes after.
Errands pile up today. Do the two that matter and park the rest.
Someone thanks you properly today. Take the compliment without explaining it away.
